Identity remains server-owned; no caller-selected actor. Whole-product parity is unfinished and the default launcher is unchanged.

OriginalHealthcheckHelp.const:
system healthcheck --company PATH [--json | --format json|human]
Offline read-only company diagnostic: company_root, data_dir, ledger, documents, config and protected snapshot schema inspection. Explicit company path required; no environment/default company. No server, cookie, local-profile, actor, stdin, repair or mutation inputs. Remote health is aggregate-only and cannot substitute this report. Human diagnostics (including failures) go to stdout; explicit JSON is pretty-printed, flat and unwrapped. Exit 0 clean, 1 diagnostic failure, 2 usage.
